posts.title: ‘A friend I can trust’: How Americans described their relationship with AI
posts.description: I helped design a poll to learn how Americans relate emotionally and socially to AIs – based in part on my prior reporting on tens of thousands of scraped conversattion logs. The poll found a huge number of Americans emotionally reliant on AI.

posts.title: See the moment when Republican politicians turned against data centers
posts.description: This chart shows how both parties were once quietly pro-data center, then, first Democrats and later Republicans, turned strongly against them, responding to popular unhappiness. For the chart, I had AI analyze thousands of social media posts, newsletters and podcasts from politicians, (validating the results (of course)).

posts.title: Why prediction markets’ election picks are useful, even when they seem wrong
posts.description: I asked: are prediction markets’ election predictions even any good? The answer I found was, yeah, they’re not bad – but the trick is in interpreting them wisely. I’m proud of this story because much of our audience seems to have believed prediction markets are good for nothing but insider trading, but their reasonable accuracy at predicting elections cuts against their instincts.
